name: Magdiel
title: Edomite tribal chieftain
summary: Magdiel was one of the tribal chieftains (alufim) descended from Esau, Jacob's twin brother. He is mentioned in the genealogies of Edom's chieftains in both Genesis and 1 Chronicles. His name possibly means 'God's precious gift' or 'God's noblest'.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the tribal chiefs of Edom
keyEvents.description: Magdiel is mentioned as one of the tribal chiefs descended from Esau in the land of Edom. This list shows the political organization of Esau's descendants in Edom.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The name Magdiel is repeated in 1 Chronicles as part of the historical overview of Edom's chiefs, confirming his role in Edom's history.

keyEvents.title: Esau's lineage established in Edom
keyEvents.description: Esau, Magdiel's ancestor, settled in the mountains of Seir and became the father of the Edomite people. His descendants were organized under tribal chiefs.

keyEvents.title: Kings and chiefs of Edom
keyEvents.description: Before Israel had kings, Edom had already established a system of kings and tribal chiefs, with Magdiel being among the last chiefs mentioned in the list.
